-   Building presentations or reports: Combine insights from multiple conversations with your other research and data
    
-   Coding with context: Give your AI the project background, requirements, and technical decisions discussed in planning meetings

Your AI assistant can search your Granola meetings by topic, person, company, or timeframe - then cite specific conversations in its responses. No more switching tabs to find "what the customer said" or "when we decided that."

-   Writing PRDs or proposals: Pull customer feedback, stakeholder input, and decisions from relevant meetings directly into your draft

Your AI assistant can search your Granola meetings by topic, person, company, or timeframe - then cite specific conversations in its responses. No more switching tabs to find "what the customer said" or "when we decided that."
